modified_caption: The pie chart illustrates the conceptual framework of 'Ever-scalingness,' divided into four equal segments representing key categories. The yellow segment, labeled 'Complexity,' is associated with the concept of 'Uncrushable' and occupies approximately 40% of the chart. The blue segment, labeled 'Instance,' is linked to 'Unhackable' and shows a slight upward trend in importance compared to the other categories. The red segment, labeled 'Scalable Oversight,' is connected to 'Auto-verifiable' and is depicted as the smallest portion of the chart, occupying roughly 15%. The green segment, labeled 'Coverage,' is associated with 'General' and is shown as the largest segment, occupying approximately 45% of the chart. The external labels are connected to their respective segments, and the chart does not include a legend or percentage labels inside the slices.

modifications.claim: The yellow segment occupies approximately 40% of the chart.
modifications.reality: Each segment occupies an equal portion of the chart, so the yellow segment is 25%, not 40%.

modifications.claim: The blue segment shows a slight upward trend in importance compared to the other categories.
modifications.reality: The chart does not depict any trends or changes in importance; all segments are static and equal in size.

modifications.claim: The red segment is depicted as the smallest portion of the chart, occupying roughly 15%.
modifications.reality: The red segment occupies an equal portion of the chart (25%), not 15%, as all segments are of equal size.
